decisions.title: Starting Trainer level
decisions.notes: Default 1; higher-level starts are campaign policy. Canonical bound: levels 1-50.

decisions.title: Base combat stats (10 HP, 5 others)
decisions.notes: Structured rule text plus runtime defaults agree; catalog must bind the numeric floor explicitly.

decisions.title: Creation and level stat-point budget (Level + 9 cumulative)
decisions.notes: 10 discretionary points at creation; +1 per level after 1; no Base Relations for Trainers.

decisions.title: Trainer Max HP formula (Level x2 + HP x3 + 10)
decisions.notes: Existing runtime authority reused by all sheets; catalog binds it as a derived contribution, not a new rule.

decisions.title: The 17 Trainer skills and rank ladder
Skill rank maximums by level (Novice at L1, Adept via background)
decisions.notes: Level 1 cap Novice with background exception Adept; L2 Adept, L6 Expert, L12 Master.

decisions.title: Skill background composition (how many Adept/Novice/Pathetic picks)
decisions.notes: The sheet stores adept/novice/pathetic arrays and the rank calculator applies them, but no app-owned structured source states the legal counts a creation background grants.

dataDefect.requiredAction: Add characterCreationMechanics.background (adept/novice/pathetic pick counts and rank effects) to data/reference/rules.json through a reviewed, source-hash-bound migration before P9-034.

decisions.title: Free Training Feature at Level 1
decisions.notes: Exactly one of Agility/Brutal/Focused/Inspired Training; canonical IDs frozen in the mechanics block.

decisions.title: Paid Feature slots (4 at L1, +1 each odd level from 3)
decisions.notes: Counted collections include features, classes, and orders; grant-acquired entries excluded.

decisions.title: Edge slots (4 at L1, +1 each even level, bonus skill edges at 2/6/12)
decisions.notes: Skill Edge IDs frozen; bonus slots restricted to that set.

decisions.title: Feature identities, prerequisites, and subchoices
decisions.notes: 444 canonical features with hash-bound prerequisite expressions and instance choice schemas.

decisions.title: Edge identities, prerequisites, and subchoices
decisions.notes: 61 Trainer Edges with typed prerequisite expressions including skill, stat-point, and choice-bound clauses.

decisions.title: Class acquisition and class Feature branches
decisions.notes: 40 classes; class anchors are Feature instances; at most 4 class Features counted per class anchor rule.

decisions.title: Action Point pool (5 + floor(level/5))
decisions.notes: Existing runtime formula; onboarding previews reuse it.

decisions.title: Starting money
decisions.notes: No app-owned structured source states a default starting money value; campaigns vary it. Policy owns the value, but the canonical default baseline must be added with provenance.

dataDefect.requiredAction: Add characterCreationMechanics.startingMoney default to data/reference/rules.json through a reviewed, source-hash-bound migration before P9-038; CampaignOnboardingPolicy overrides it explicitly.

decisions.title: Starting inventory and equipment package
decisions.notes: Item identities and equipment authority are canonical; which items a new Trainer starts with is pure campaign policy (P9-029).

decisions.title: Trainer capability defaults (Overland 5, Throwing Range, Power, Jump)
decisions.notes: Athletics-derived defaults already implemented and rule-backed.

decisions.title: Level 5/10/20/30/40 milestone choices for higher-level starts
decisions.notes: Higher-level onboarding starts must collect these choices; new characters at level 1 have none.

decisions.title: Identity and presentation fields (name, age, sex, portrait, accent)
decisions.notes: Bounded free-text and asset fields; no canonical rule constrains them beyond sheet schema.
